concepts.quote: result is 50 because default always runs at the end of a switch.
concepts.why: The final value 50 is right, but the reason breaks a Java rule: default does not always run. Here it runs only because value 2 has no break and falls through cases 3 and 4 into default.
The answer says nothing about statements or the order they run in.
The answer gives a final value but doesn't explain how the assignments store or overwrite values.
The code has no counter and the answer doesn't mention one.
